why: Two men bent over a map, planning: getting organized in the middle of a mess.
A plain planted field with a scarecrow: slow, boring work that pays off, not a bold move.
Figures kneeling before a temple where a robed figure stands in the light: asking the oracle, once.
A night market stall with coins on the table and people browsing: asking again is shopping for an answer.
A man fishing by a calm river with a basket beside him: patient, easy waiting.
Two people eating a meal by candlelight: eat and rest while you wait.
Two men with crossed swords, locked mid-fight: a conflict that should stop here.
A man alone at a table with his head in his hands: what pushing the fight to the end costs.
A calm, glowing leader standing before a band of armed men: the grown-up the army needs.
A robed leader at a fire cauldron with a crowd gathered around him: feeding people first.
People dancing in a ring holding hands under a bright sun: join now.
An empty banquet table with scraps, the party over: late arrivals miss out.
Seeds lying in the dark soil, rooted but not yet sprouted: not yet.
A woman bent over a loom, working carefully: work on yourself in the meantime.
A lone figure with a lamp stepping along a cliff edge: mind how you step.
A man kneeling calmly beside a large snake that stays still: act well and it won't flare.
A figure walking down a green forest path: keep it moving.
Two people clasping hands at an open doorway, fields behind them: peace is contact.
A lone figure walking away into a dark forest: holding back, withdrawing.
A man examining a coin under a lamp beside a set of scales: checking the deal before taking it.
A wide-open gate with a rider coming through: keep it open.
People walking up a path toward the viewer, arm in arm: new people walking up.
A blazing sun over a golden village and fields: great possession, and everyone sees it.
One man handing another a sapling to plant on a bare slope: using what you have to put things right.
An old craftsman bent over his work alone at a bench: finishing quietly.
A stream running through a rocky gorge: nothing stops the quiet water.
A weaver at a loom turning threads into cloth: giving the energy a shape.
A woman with a packed bundle walking out through an open gate: organized, then moving.
